assign.outcome:
**Sixteen more notebook spreads are pages you can browse.** Images 023-038 of the inbox, each read at 1600px, transcribed in full, linked to what the site built from it, and built where it drew an interface.

![](shot.jpg)

**The sixteen** — [AI research, and a list of UI/UX](/notes/ai-research-list-ui-ux/) · [Split responsive viewer](/notes/split-responsive-viewer/) · [I need to simplify my website](/notes/simplify-my-website/) · [Laws, rules, suggestions](/notes/laws-rules-suggestions/) · [Short-minded](/notes/short-minded/) · [Analyze the spacing as a percent](/notes/analyze-spacing-as-percent/) · [Column vs swap](/notes/column-vs-swap/) · [The editor](/notes/the-editor/) · [Edit mode with a toolbar](/notes/edit-mode-toolbar/) · [My docs are bad](/notes/my-docs-are-bad/) · [The rule that shows a page](/notes/page-active-display/) · [Tabs, and lazy pages](/notes/tabs-and-lazy-pages/) · [We think](/notes/we-think/) · [Load, but don't render](/notes/load-but-dont-render/) · [Nested rendering](/notes/nested-rendering/) · [Readme 1 - N](/notes/readme-one-to-n/)

**Four of them build the thing they draw.** 023 the ranked layout strip; 029 column vs swap as two live frames you click a child in; 030 the editor as a wireframe with a working layers panel, viewport and fullscreen; 037 the five status colours as swatches painted from the site's own tokens. The other twelve say in one line why nothing was built - every interface they draw is already live and larger, and a note-sized copy would teach less than opening it.

**Two findings.** `ext/CSSDoc` and `core/new/1/agents/` render the 404 page (no `page.js`, undeclared) - neither is linked, and the notes that wanted them point at [`styles/rules`](/framework/styles/rules/) and [`/framework/ai/`](/framework/ai/) instead. And the site has no blue: four of the note's five status colours are real tokens, `info` is the gap, shown on [Nested rendering](/notes/nested-rendering/) as a swatch that visibly does not match.

**Proved.** All 16 pages plus [/notes/](/notes/) at 400 / 1280 / 1920 / 3440: zero console errors, no sideways scroll, no missing pages, every one of the 78 links on them resolves. Both interactive builds driven headless.

**Left out on purpose.** The owner's name (035, 036) and third parties' names (027, 028) are "the owner" and initials; 024's apartment line is dropped. Each of those five pages links the original photo, which only opens on a local checkout. `public/notes/readme.md` is outside this task's write fence and is untouched.
